mode: Actual Kitty, Neovim, Rust server and Pi; all actions use terminal keys
responses: Synthetic faux replies; actual Bash child creation

steps.text: Start Harness from the project. Neovim keeps the normal file window.
Press ; for agents. Press n for a new saved chat. No setup form blocks it.
F1 opens chat actions while the complete task stays in the message box.
Escape cancels model selection. Typing continues without losing a character.
Choose the local demo for this reproducible test. No paid model request runs.
Ctrl-^ switches to the source. The chat input closes. Edit without saving.
Return to the chat. F1 attaches the unsaved source and keeps the task.
Enter sends. The actual Pi Bash tool creates a child agent. The answer streams into the chat.
Select the nested Tests agent in the tree. It has a separate conversation and draft.
NERDTree s opens a file beside the chat with normal Vim split behavior.
Return to the chat. Its small input stays under that chat, with its draft intact.
Save the source and close Neovim. Stored chats remain available.

lines: This is an isolated test project.
